label: Token-budgeted v2 decision templates
readout: Sum of log probabilities of numeric bracket suffixes; exact shared-prefix trie; conditional softmax, not calibrated on DOM tasks

inferenceConfiguration.promptFrame: Direct instructions and numeric bracket prefill; no chat wrapper
inferenceConfiguration.budgetPolicy: First ordered tier fitting 2048 tokens including complete suffix; if none fit retain smallest tier and count explicit inference failure. No labels are inspected.

reuse.policy: Reuse only identical case/template/prompt/ordered-option IDs/index base and pinned model/scorer implementation. Reused latency remains its original observation.
